name: How long does coordinated electrical work typically take during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: How long does coordinated electrical work typically take during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rough electrical work generally takes between two to five days for an average kitchen or bathroom, though whole-basement remodels can take longer depending on circuit counts. Because HH Remodeling manages the schedule directly, we align our carpentry completion to lead right into electrical rough-ins without multi-week gaps. Once the wiring passes inspection, our crew moves directly into insulation and drywall, keeping the entire renovation timeline moving steadily.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rough electrical takes two to five days for most kitchens and baths, after which drywall and finish carpentry begin immediately.
